positive.reasoning: Criterion A1 (traumatic event): MET — patient described experiencing a highly distressing event where they felt their life was in danger. Criterion B1 (re-experiencing): MET — patient reported recurrent memories of the event that intrude on their thoughts. Criterion B2 (avoidance of thoughts): MET — patient stated they have made efforts to avoid thinking about the event. Criterion B3 (avoidance of reminders): MET — patient avoids places and conversations that remind them of the event. Criterion B4 (inability to recall details): MET — patient mentioned difficulty recalling parts of the event. Criterion C1 (negative beliefs about self/others): MET — patient expressed persistent negativity and difficulty trusting others. Criterion C2 (blame): MET — patient reported ongoing self-blame regarding the event. Criterion C3 (negative emotional state): MET — patient described consistently negative feelings such as fear and anxiety. Criterion C4 (diminished interest): MET — patient indicated a lack of interest in previously meaningful activities. Criterion C5 (detachment): MET — patient reported feeling disconnected from others. Criterion C6 (inability to experience positive emotions): MET — patient stated they find it difficult to feel satisfied or joyful. Criterion D1 (irritability): MET — patient reported increased irritability and outbursts of anger. Criterion D2 (recklessness): MET — patient acknowledged engaging in impulsive behaviors. Criterion D3 (hypervigilance): MET — patient described being more alert and on edge. Criterion D4 (startle response): MET — patient reported being more easily startled. Criterion D5 (concentration difficulties): MET — patient noted difficulty concentrating. Criterion D6 (sleep disturbances): MET — patient reported having trouble sleeping. Criterion E (duration): MET — symptoms began after the traumatic event and have lasted for more than a month. Criterion F (functional impairment): MET — patient indicated significant distress and interference with functioning at home and socially. Criterion G (exclusion): NOT MET — patient denied substance use or other medical conditions that could explain symptoms. Total: 20 of 20 criteria met (threshold ≥1). Diagnosis: TRUE — full criteria for PTSD are met with significant functional impairment confirmed.
